name: driftproof
description: Three doors onto the Driftproof CLI: scaffold a skill's evaluation suite, measure it against a model, and render a badge from the receipt. The CLI is the product and it runs on every surface Driftproof measures, while the plugin is one install path for Claude Code users. It measures and never edits a skill. This version pins the runner it wraps: the plugin's version IS the npm version every command invokes.
